Hi Sara —

Great to meet you and Tom on the call today. Thanks for walking through the primary goals for the POC. To recap quickly and keep momentum:

- Success criteria we heard: 1) 99th percentile response latency <= 400ms at target concurrency, 2) per-unit inference cost under your SLA target (we'll map token budgets), and 3) model quality parity with your current baseline on the 3 evaluation prompts you shared.
- Proposed timeline: kickoff next Monday (10/19), 2-week POC (10/19-11/02) with an optional 1-week extension for rollout validation.
- Owner for technical intake: Marissa (SE) will own workload profiling and test harness setup.
- Owner for commercial/administrative: Ben (me) will own contract/credits and mutual action plan.

Next steps I need from your side to scope infra and finalize the trial:
1) Workload profile (rough numbers are fine): RPS (avg/peak), typical and max token lengths (prompt + completion), concurrency, burst patterns (e.g., traffic spikes per hour/day/week), and any hard rate-limits on your side.
2) Sample payloads or a snippet of typical prompts (redact PII).
3) Confirmation on evaluation set and who will sign off on success criteria.

Attached is our POC intake template (redwood-poc-workload-intake-template.xlsx) — if you can fill the key fields and return, Marissa and I will turn it into a test plan and infra estimate.

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min call if helpful — otherwise a reply with the intake is perfect.

Thanks,

Thanks for the details, Sara — good signals. I ran a quick hypothesis pass on infra and test plan. Top-line notes and POC asks below.

Technical summary / assumptions (please confirm):
- Steady-state 12 RPS -> should be inexpensive with batching; ensure your gateway does not fragment requests (we prefer longer lived gRPC/HTTP2 connections).
- Peak bursts to 120 RPS for ~2-3 minutes -> we recommend autoscale policy to add capacity for short bursts and an explicit burst pool.
- Avg token sizes: prompt 200 + completion 600 = 800 tokens average; worst-case 4,000 tokens.
- Concurrency: 60 concurrent users aligns with queueing; we'll size pools for ~80 concurrent streams to provide headroom.
\Recommended POC profile:
- Duration: 2 weeks (10/19-11/02) with daily synthetic traffic that mirrors your recorded burst patterns plus a few production shadowing hours.
- Infra (hosted): a dedicated trial pool with mixed GPU types: 1-2 L4-like instances for control/max throughput tests + 2x A10x-equivalent for cost/latency tuning. We can run quantized variants if model quality holds.
- Batching policy: dynamic batching with max batch latency 20ms; tokenizer-aware batching to avoid exceeding memory on 4k examples.
- KV cache: enable prefix caching for repeated context (saw several repeated prompts in sample set).
\Success criteria (draft):
1) 99th percentile latency <= 450ms on average POC traffic (including bursts).
2) Mean inference cost <= target $0.007/token (TBD with finance) under the recommended config.
3) Quality: >= 95% of baseline score on the 3 evaluation prompts (Tom to confirm dataset).
\POC deliverables / owner list:
- Workload intake & tokenized payloads: Sara (FintechCo)
- Test harness + runnable load profile: Marissa (Redwood SE)
- Contract/credits + MAP: Ben (Redwood Sales)
- Success signoff: Tom (Product Lead, FintechCo)
\Small asks to finalize:
- Sara: can you attach one redacted transcript that hits the 4k token path? We need to validate memory and tail latency.
- Tom: can you share the 10 evaluation prompts and expected pass/fail criteria?
\I'll draft a runnable test plan and an infra estimate by EOD Wednesday (10/14).
\Marissa
